results.title: Jungle - Move Like You Do MV
results.description: Jungle released the next standalone video from their "Sunshine" visual album for "Move Like You Do" I forked over the 7 bucks to watch the full thing this week. I'm not as captivated as I was with the previous film for "Volcano" (i've lost count how many times I've watched it), but it was a nice, tight feature in a nice location. The choreography for all 11 videos was done by lead dancer Will West, as opposed to the frequent choreographer of their past numerous projects, Shay Latukolan. Source
